releases.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: 5.6 - bug fixes first, then continuous compaction by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/43


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/metraton/gaia/compare/v5.5.0...v5.6.0

## What's Changed
* feat(security): refuse shell-authored writes into a git working tree by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/14
* fix(security): treat the active gh account as shared state by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/15
* fix(security): enforce mutative tier floor by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/16
* fix(security): prevent secret values from reaching output by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/17
* fix(ci): provision runtimes and repair portable test fixtures by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/18
* test: fix attestation CLI fixture by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/19
* fix(opencode): transport shell identity and attest children early by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/20
* fix(retention): make worktree reclaim idempotent by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/22
* fix(task): preserve verification gate and close override state by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/21
* docs(orchestrator): restore identity invariants by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/23
* fix(gaia): align capability surfaces by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/24
* feat(review): add portable code review workflow by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/25
* fix(hooks): preserve redirects inside quoted arguments by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/26
* feat(opencode): sealed consent control plane, install provenance and 5.5.0-rc.1 by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/27
* fix(tests): teach the payload tripwire the field PR 27 added by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/28
* fix(security): close seven ways a guard could fail open by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/29
* fix(opencode): make approval retries host-agnostic by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/30
* fix(ci): contain GAIA_HOST leak, audit replayed approvals, realign fixtures by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/31
* chore: remove dead code, support only Python 3.12, isolate CLAUDE_SESSION_ID in tests by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/32
* fix(worktree): place worktrees beside the registered workspace, from the remote default branch by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/33
* fix(hooks): refuse Claude attribution in published text and settings by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/34
* feat(brief-plan): managed briefs and plans with computed done (schema v57) by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/35
* fix(hooks): treat a quoted heredoc fed to a gaia --*-file - flag as data by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/36
* feat(approvals): one approval core for Claude Code and OpenCode by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/37
* fix(approvals): what the live tests found in Claude Code and OpenCode, and the self-approval fence by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/38
* fix(release): make the sandbox gate self-contained and doctor honest about tarball installs by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/39
* fix(agents): recognise plugin-prefixed agent names in every identity check by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/40
* fix(plugin): publish the gaia CLI path and register hooks once in plugin mode by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/41
* feat(usage): token usage per message and brief history (schema v58) by @metraton in https://github.com/metraton/gaia/pull/42


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/metraton/gaia/compare/v5.3.0...v5.5.0
